name: vllm_copy_blocks_mla
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench vLLM test_copy_blocks_mla.py. Copies MLA KV cache blocks per a block_mapping. gen_inputs builds a single-element list kv_caches=[randn(num_blocks,block_size,kv_dim)] fp16 and a non-overlapping block_mapping=stack(perm[:m], perm[m:2m]) int64 (matches the test's randperm scheme). run() mutates the list in place and returns it. config=(num_blocks, block_size, kv_dim, num_mappings). Exact PyTree comparison. Requires vLLM at eval time.
